# eon_restore_account_region_encryption_keys (Data Source)

Retrieves the encryption keys available to Eon in a region of a restore account. Use this data source to select values for `eon_restore_job` encryption key fields, such as `encryption_key_id` and `kms_key_id`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Example: List encryption keys available in a region of a restore account
data "eon_restore_account_region_encryption_keys" "demo" {
  account_id = "11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111"
  region     = "us-east-1"
}

# Example: Include AWS-managed keys
data "eon_restore_account_region_encryption_keys" "with_aws_managed" {
  account_id               = "11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111"
  region                   = "us-east-1"
  include_aws_managed_keys = true
}

output "first_encryption_key_arn" {
  description = "First listed encryption key ARN for the region"
  value       = try(data.eon_restore_account_region_encryption_keys.demo.keys[0].arn, null)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `account_id` (String) Eon-assigned ID of the restore account.
- `region` (String) Region where the encryption keys are located.

### Optional

- `include_aws_managed_keys` (Boolean) Whether to include AWS-managed keys in the response.

### Read-Only

- `keys` (Attributes List) List of encryption keys available in the region. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--keys))

<a id="nestedatt--keys"></a>
### Nested Schema for `keys`

Read-Only:

- `alias_name` (String) Encryption key alias.
- `arn` (String) ARN of the encryption key.
- `id` (String) Cloud-provider-assigned ID of the encryption key.
